Paragraph: "Look at this grassy expanse, Soumitri, covered with various fallen flowers! It looks like a magnificent couch prepared for royalty..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Viewing the lush, flower-strewn meadow that resembles a royal bed.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama uses rich poetic imagery to describe the beauty of the natural floor.
Outcome/Resolution: He briefly finds aesthetic wonder in the natural landscape.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shayya (Seeing nature's provision as a divine bed/resting place)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Nature naturally provides royal comfort to those living in alignment with Dharma, turning a wild forest into a sacred palace.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Engaging creative visualization to transform simple natural surroundings into comforting and regal mental concepts.
